description: The bar chart illustrates the number of experts across 24 layers for two groups, G1 and G2, in a study on efficient multilingual expansion for large language models (LLMs). The horizontal axis represents the layers, labeled from 1 to 24, while the vertical axis indicates the number of experts, ranging from 0 to 10. Each layer is represented by a grouped bar, with G1 shown in green and G2 in yellow. The chart includes a legend in the upper right corner, identifying the colors associated with each group. The bars are uniformly distributed across the layers, with no specific sorting or emphasis on any particular layer. The values for each bar are not explicitly provided, but the chart shows a consistent number of experts across all layers for both groups.
